approved_task_config.title: Compatible bounded-above resolutions with split transition maps for an arbitrary complex

standard_prerequisites.name: Bounded-above resolutions by an epimorphism-generating class
standard_prerequisites.statement: A bounded-above complex has a termwise surjective quasi-isomorphism from a bounded-above complex in P if every object is a quotient of an object in P.

standard_prerequisites.name: Homotopy-category triangles
standard_prerequisites.statement: The homotopy category of an abelian category is triangulated; any distinguished triangle is isomorphic to one arising from a termwise split exact sequence. Standard cone formulas and long exact cohomology are allowed.

core_obligations: Build the next resolution through a cone and a split distinguished triangle, then lift and subtract a homotopy so the truncation diagram commutes as complexes rather than only up to homotopy.
Restore termwise surjectivity by adding a two-term contractible complex in the two new degrees while preserving the quasi-isomorphism and split transition cokernels.
